Mapping shift over any integer list equals mapping subtraction of three. Deliver solve and shift in program.vscore.json with typed total evaluation, deterministic results, preserved inputs, no external I/O or floating point, pure data and the restricted runtime. These source requirements are independently required and also part of the value guarantee. This is a restricted source contract. The integer input domain is inhabited: every mathematical integer equals itself, and integer zero is a constructive domain witness.
